name: Omachines
author: atlastimed
description: Windows and Omarchy VM controls, agent connections and complete backups in the Omarchy bar.

schema.label: Connection check interval (seconds)
schema.description: One check shared by every monitor. Lightweight status updates every 15 seconds; Check connections performs a fresh guest probe.

schema.label: Operation notifications
schema.description: Notify when backups or lifecycle operations finish or fail.

schema.label: Aside integration
schema.description: Show Aside controls for the Windows VM and check its local browser connection. Never starts AI tasks.

schema.label: Legacy Windows setup workspace
schema.description: Optional v0.1 backup provider and completion records. The installed v0.2 administrator helper provides built-in backups.
